name: AutoGen
description: Microsoft's programming framework for agentic AI. Enables building multi-agent systems with conversable, customizable agents that collaborate via structured conversations.

name: LangChain
description: The agent engineering platform. Composable framework for building LLM-powered applications, agents, and complex reasoning chains with tools and memory.

name: LangGraph
description: Build resilient, stateful agents as graphs. Provides durable execution, human-in-the-loop, and long-running workflows for production agent systems.

name: CrewAI
description: Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents. Enables crews of agents with defined roles, goals, and tools to collaborate on complex tasks.

name: MetaGPT
description: The Multi-Agent Framework that simulates a full software company. Assigns roles (PM, architect, engineer) to agents that collaborate on code generation pipelines.

name: CAMEL
description: The first and best multi-agent framework. Finding the Scaling Laws of Agents. Pioneered role-playing autonomous agents with inception prompting.

name: OpenAI Agents SDK
description: A lightweight, powerful framework for multi-agent workflows from OpenAI. Provides agents, handoffs, guardrails, and tracing for production agent systems.

name: Pydantic AI
description: AI Agent Framework, the Pydantic way. Type-safe agents with FastAPI-style ergonomics, validation, and dependency injection for production LLM apps.

name: Mastra
description: The modern TypeScript framework for AI-powered applications and agents. Type-safe workflows, tool integration, and observability for JS/TS agent stacks.

name: ElizaOS
description: Open source agentic operating system. Multi-agent platform for autonomous AI characters across social platforms, Discord, and web with persistent memory.

name: Haystack
description: Open-source AI orchestration framework for building context-engineered, production-ready LLM applications including agents, RAG pipelines, and multi-modal workflows.

name: SuperAGI
description: A dev-first open source autonomous AI agent framework. Enables building, managing, and running autonomous agents with toolkits, memory, and GUI.

name: Agent Zero
description: Agent Zero AI framework. General-purpose personal assistant with hierarchical multi-agent architecture, computer use, and persistent learning capabilities.

name: nanobot
description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python. Minimal footprint agent runtime for local and production deployments.

name: Smolagents
description: Hugging Face's minimal agent library. Code-writing agents that perform tasks by writing Python, with safe execution and tool integration.

name: AutoGPT
description: An autonomous AI agent platform that chains LLM calls to accomplish goals. One of the first popular fully autonomous agent frameworks with a marketplace.

name: Semantic Kernel
description: Microsoft's SDK for integrating AI into .NET, Python, and Java applications. Provides agents, planners, and orchestration for enterprise AI workflows.

name: Agno
description: Full-stack agent framework with built-in memory, knowledge, session management, and multi-modal support. Designed for production agent deployment.

name: Letta
description: Open-source framework for stateful agents with advanced memory architectures. Brings scalable memory and context management to long-running agents.

name: Browser-Use
description: Make websites accessible to AI agents. Browser automation framework that lets LLMs interact with web pages via natural language commands.

name: Phidata
description: Build AI agents with memory, knowledge, and tools. Add specialized agents to your application with a UI and reasoning capabilities.

name: Pipecat
description: Open source framework for voice agents, multimodal apps, and realtime AI. Pipeline architecture for low-latency conversational agent applications.

name: Strands Agents
description: AWS-built model-driven agent SDK. Build agents using a simple model-driven approach with tools, system prompts, and structured outputs.

name: Atomic Agents
description: Framework for building modular, scalable agentic systems using atomic, composable components. Based on the instructor library for structured outputs.

name: BabyAGI
description: An isolated, SQLite-powered task management system for autonomous AI agents. Pioneered the task-driven autonomous agent loop with prioritized task creation.
